# hg onboard

**What this page tells you:** every `hg onboard` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Register a repo, or one agent, with the local loop.

## Synopsis

```text
hg onboard <./path | repo-url> [flags]
```

## Description

Registers a profile directory OR a whole catalogue (`distributions/*` + `.hermes-dist/*`). All discovered profiles boot on the next `hg up` unless `--profile` narrows to one.

## Flags

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow a catalogue to one profile. |
| `--env` | `<path/.env>` | — | Pin a dotenv file (default: `<root>/.env` plus per-profile `.env`). |

## Examples

```bash
hg onboard ../my-team
hg onboard ../repo --profile research
```
